acts.desc: Ira's mom is invited to speak to a group of Jewish mothers who only discuss one topic: their relationships with their adult children. So she calls Ira and his siblings to ask their advice .
acts.label: Prologue
Act One
acts.desc: Ira continues the story about his conversation with his mom. Then he calls her up on the air.
acts.title: Me and My Mom

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: A story about how the adult children in Sandra Tsing Loh 's family deal with her father. This story originally appeared in her book Depth Takes a Holiday .
acts.title: Sandra's Dad

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: Sandra's father decides, at age 70, to take a Chinese wife.
acts.title: My Father's Chinese Wives
